description: Unique evidence record identifier.
Article-level metadata including DOI, title, journal, year, authors and source path when available.
Structured study context including study object, intervention, comparison and outcome metrics.
Extracted biomedical entities with raw name, semantic class and normalized identifier when available.
Disease context for the record: HCC, CRC or SLE.
Reported biological mechanism text when available.
Reported phenotype, clinical outcome or biological effect when available.
Assay, model, patient group, trial or other study context.
Study type label such as cohort, rct, in_vivo, in_vitro, meta_analysis, case_control or computational.
Translational stage label such as preclinical, clinical, phase_i, phase_ii, phase_iii or phase_iv.
Extracted quantitative attributes including p_value, sample_size, fold_change, confidence_interval and effect_size.
Computational evidence-quality metadata including component scores, composite score and grade level.
Supporting text span from the source article.
List of normalized TarKG-compatible entity identifiers linked from the record.
Relations from this evidence record to other evidence records.
Identifiers of records absorbed during duplicate handling.
Curation status field retained for future manual review.
Boolean flag indicating directed graph representation.
Boolean flag indicating whether parallel edges are represented.
Release-level graph metadata.
Evidence nodes and normalized entity nodes.
Evidence-to-entity and evidence-to-evidence edge records.
